svg.title: The recorder is just another listener on the bus
svg.desc: The event bus feeds two paths. The control path runs to automations and services. The recorder path writes batches through SQLAlchemy to one SQLite file, which feeds history, the API and long-term statistics.

svg.text: The recorder is just another listener on the bus
It writes in batches to one SQLite file, so a slow disk never stops the lights
